# neon_branches (Data Source)

Fetch Project Branches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "neon_branches" "example" {
  project_id = "cool-moon-42"
  filter     = "main"
}

output "branch_names" {
  value = [for branch in data.neon_branches.example.branches : branch.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter by partial branch name or ID.

### Read-Only

- `branches` (Attributes List) Project branches in API response order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branches))
- `id` (String) Project ID.

<a id="nestedatt--branches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branches`

Read-Only:

- `default` (Boolean) Default branch flag.
- `id` (String) Branch ID.
- `logical_size` (Number) Branch logical size in bytes.
- `name` (String) Branch name.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent branch ID.
- `parent_lsn` (String) Parent branch Log Sequence Number (LSN).
- `parent_timestamp` (Number) Parent branch point-in-time timestamp in Unix seconds. Zero when not provided by the API.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `protected` (Boolean) Protected branch flag.
